app.title: llm-launchpad
app.subtitle: Pick a model and launch a GPU instance for it

models.cappedHelp: The selected context length is over this model's max ({{max}}), so the estimate uses the max.
models.tightHelp: Less than 1 GiB of VRAM is left. It may not fit on a real instance, so consider the next type up.
models.selectPrompt: Pick a model from the list to see the VRAM breakdown and the recommended instance type.
models.vramBarLabel: VRAM needed {{required}} GiB of {{total}} GiB on the instance
models.fittingTypes: Instance types that fit (in the order they are picked)
models.estimateNote: Estimates are approximate. They assume Ollama serves one request at a time.

region.heading: Region and model storage for {{model}}
region.loadFailed: Could not load prices or region details: {{error}}
region.moveNotice: {{region}} needs its own model storage (an S3 bucket or EBS volume). Changing the region means putting the model there again, since buckets and volumes belong to one region.
region.notOffered: {{type}} is not available in this region. Pick another region.

storageHelp.s3_cache: Copies the model from S3. If it is not in S3 yet, downloads it and saves it to S3 once ready. Cheapest while stopped
storageHelp.ebs: Attaches an EBS volume that keeps the model. Nothing to download, but loading from the volume is slower and storage costs more
storageHelp.download: Downloads from the Ollama library every time. No storage cost

region.ebsThroughput: (of which {{price}} is the {{throughput}} MiB/s throughput of the {{size}} GiB volume)
region.startupFirstLater: first time about {{first}} min / later about {{later}} min

prerequisite.bucket: There is no bucket in {{region}} yet. Apply terraform/model-store first.
prerequisite.volume: There is no EBS volume in {{region}} yet. Create one with model_volumes in terraform/model-store first.

region.hourlyTotalDetail: {{onDemand}}/hour on-demand. Instance, root volume ({{disk}} GiB) and storage added together
region.note: Prices are estimates from the AWS Price List API and spot price history, and differ from the actual bill. Startup time is from terraform apply until ready, worked out from a measurement ({{source}}).

terraform.heading: Terraform
terraform.description: Each button runs a command in terraform/ and streams its output here.

commandHelp.version: Show the Terraform and provider versions
commandHelp.init: Install providers and modules (run once first)
commandHelp.plan: Preview what would be created (creates nothing)

terraform.planNeedsVars: plan needs terraform/terraform.tfvars (or the values picked in this UI).
